title: Retrying what is worth retrying
summary: Retries a request that failed for a reason another attempt could change — and only when trying again is safe. Queries are retried by default; a command has to declare itself idempotent first.
useWhen: A dependency is sometimes unavailable. Do not write a retry loop in a handler, and do not reach for a general-purpose retry policy — those fire on exceptions, and a Zero failure is a returned value.
